description:
Get mouse knockout phenotypes for a target.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table mouse_phenotype — one record = one mouse phenotype observed in models of one mouse orthologue of one human gene.
Key: targetFromSourceId, targetInModelEnsemblId, modelPhenotypeId (targetInModelEnsemblId may be null).
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by modelPhenotypeId asc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. IMPC/MGI mouse phenotypes of orthologues of the human gene; absence means no phenotype curated.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
